description:
I need a red bull for bedtime routines these days… #dog #husky #goldenretriever #dogs #puppy

Trying to maintain a consistent bedtime routine with these two is an absolute workout! Watch how they get tucked in.

Getting a husky and a golden retriever settled for the night is never easy, especially when they are wearing their favorite dog pajamas. Tonight, we are tackling the bunk beds to see who can actually stay put long enough to fall asleep.

It is a chaotic but hilarious process involving plenty of energy, even when they are supposed to be winding down. Whether you have a puppy or an older pet, you know the struggle of getting them ready for bed. Let us know in the comments if your pets are this energetic at night!
